qe: What is the 'Weighted Voting' system in the GST Council?
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 279A. \n2. Logic: Koi bhi decision lene ke liye 75% (3//4th) majority chahiye. \n3. Extra Fact: Iska matlab hai ki Centre aur States dono ki sahamati ke bina koi bada badlav nahi ho sakta.

qe: Which Constitutional Body is responsible for determining the 'Criteria' for distributing grants to States?
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 275. \n2. Logic: Finance Commission hi tay karta hai ki kis state ko (jaise Bihar ko) kitni extra financial help (grants-in-aid) ki zaroorat hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Isse states ke beech ka financial gap kam hota hai.

qe: Can the 'Supreme Court' review the advice given by the Election Commission to the President?
e: 1. Core Concept: Judicial Review. \n2. Logic: Samvidhan mein kuch bhi 'Absolute' nahi hai. Agar advice galat logic par hai, toh Court use check kar sakta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Ye power democratic integrity ko bachane ke liye hai.

qe: The 'Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities' belongs to which service?
e: 1. Core Concept: Administrative Nature. \n2. Logic: Ye ek Commissioner rank ka officer hota hai jo bhashayi samasyaon ko samajhta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Article 350B ke tehat ye President ke under aata hai.

qe: Who has the power to 'Extend' the functions of the State Public Service Commission (BPSC)?
o: State Legislature by Law (राज्य विधानमंडल कानून बनाकर)
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 321. \n2. Logic: Agar Bihar Govt chahti hai ki BPSC kuch naye exams (jaise Municipal exams) bhi conduct kare, toh Assembly ko kanoon pass karna hoga. \n3. Extra Fact: UPSC ke liye yahi power Parliament ke paas hai.

qe: The 'National Commission for SC' (Art 338) was made a multi-member body by which amendment?
e: 1. Core Concept: Institutional Reform. \n2. Logic: 1990 mein 65th Amendment se ek officer ki jagah pura commission banaya gaya. \n3. Extra Fact: Isse pehle sirf ek 'Special Officer' hota tha.

qe: Which Body maintains the 'Common Electoral Roll' for both Parliament and State elections?
o: Election Commission of India (भारत का निर्वाचन आयोग)
e: 1. Core Concept: Centralized Voter List. \n2. Logic: ECI hi poore desh ki voter list manage karta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: SEC (State Election Commission) sirf Panchayato ke liye apni alag list bana sakta hai.

qe: Under Article 148, CAG's salary is decided by?
e: 1. Core Concept: Legislative Control on Post. \n2. Logic: Samvidhan ne power Sansad ko di hai taaki Executive (sarkar) manmani na kar sake. \n3. Extra Fact: Salary Parliament tay karti hai, par milti Consolidated Fund se hai.

qe: The 'Finance Commission' can advise on 'Any other matter' referred by?
o: The President in interests of sound finance (सुदृढ़ वित्त के हित में राष्ट्रपति)
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 280(3)(d). \n2. Logic: Agar President ko lage ki desh ki arthvyavastha ke liye kuch extra rai chahiye, toh wo FC ko bol sakta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: FC ka main kaam tax sharing hi hota hai.

qe: Can a person be a member of 'Two' Public Service Commissions at once?
e: 1. Core Concept: Conflict of Interest. \n2. Logic: Article 319 ke tehat 'Double Membership' par rok hai taaki fairness bani rahe. \n3. Extra Fact: Wo ek chhod kar dusre mein join kar sakta hai par dono sath nahi.

qe: Who is the 'Highest Executive Officer' of the National Commission for STs?
e: 1. Core Concept: Leadership structure. \n2. Logic: Chairman hi poore commission ka head hota hai jise 'Cabinet Minister' ka rank milta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: VC (Vice Chairman) ko Minister of State ka rank milta hai.

qe: Article 329 bars the 'Interference of Courts' in?
o: Electoral matters like boundary marking (परिसीमन जैसे चुनावी मामले)
e: 1. Core Concept: Smooth Elections. \n2. Logic: Agar court har baar boundaries (Delimitation) par stay laga dega, toh election kabhi nahi honge. \n3. Extra Fact: Election ke BAAD court 'Election Petition' sun sakta hai.

qe: The 'Advocate General' of Bihar can be removed by the Governor. On what ground?
o: No specific ground (Governor's pleasure - किसी भी समय)
e: 1. Core Concept: Pleasure Principle. \n2. Logic: Advocate General ka koi fixed tenure nahi hota. Wo sarkar ke sath aata hai aur Governor jab chahe use hata sakta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Attorney General (Centre) ke liye bhi yahi rule hai.

qe: Which Constitutional body is the 'Friend, Philosopher and Guide' of PAC?
e: 1. Core Concept: Audit synergy. \n2. Logic: PAC ko accounts samajhne ke liye CAG ki expert help chahiye hoti hai. \n3. Extra Fact: CAG PAC ki meetings mein bhi bhag leta hai.

qe: Article 338B deals with NCBC. Is it mandatory to consult this commission on policy matters of OBCs?
o: Yes, for both Centre and States (हाँ, केंद्र और राज्यों दोनों के लिए)
e: 1. Core Concept: Consultative Power. \n2. Logic: Agar sarkar OBCs ke liye koi naya kanoon lati hai, toh use NCBC ki rai leni hi hogi. \n3. Extra Fact: Ye power ise 102nd Amendment se mili.

qe: Who provides staff to the 'State Election Commission' (SEC) in Bihar?
e: 1. Core Concept: Local Governance support. \n2. Logic: Article 243K(3) ke tehat Governor ki zimmedari hai SEC ko manpower dena. \n3. Extra Fact: Zyadatar teachers aur block officers election duty karte hain.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Salary and conditions of service' of CAG?
e: 1. Core Concept: Post creation. \n2. Logic: 148 mein hi CAG ka pura framework diya gaya hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Uski salary SC judge ke barabar hoti hai.

qe: The 'Election Commission' has became a 3-member body for the FIRST time in which year?
e: 1. Core Concept: Historical Transition. \n2. Logic: October 1989 mein age limit 21 se 18 hone par pehli baar iska vistar hua. \n3. Extra Fact: Ye vistar temporary tha, 1993 mein permanently 3-member bana.

qe: Which Constitutional body acts as the 'Advisory' to Governor for MLA disqualification?
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 192. \n2. Logic: Governor ko ECI ki rai leni hoti hai aur wo 'Binding' hoti hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Ye sirf 'Office of Profit' jaise cases ke liye hai.

qe: Does the 'Attorney General' have the right of audience in ALL courts in India?
e: 1. Core Concept: Highest Law Officer status. \n2. Logic: Article 76(3) use kisi bhi Indian court mein baithne aur sarkar ko represent karne ka haq deta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Use wahi privileges milte hain jo ek MP ko.

qe: Under Article 280, 'Finance Commission' consists of how many members including Chairman?
e: 1. Core Concept: Composition. \n2. Logic: 1 Chairman + 4 Members = 5. \n3. Extra Fact: Inhe har 5 saal mein President appoint karta hai.

qe: The 'Union Public Service Commission' annual report is laid before Parliament by?
e: 1. Core Concept: Accountability to Parliament. \n2. Logic: UPSC President ko report deta hai, aur President use dono Houses mein rakhwate hain. \n3. Extra Fact: Agar koi recommendation nahi maani gayi, toh sarkar ko reason batana padta hai.

qe: Which Constitutional body determines the 'Model Code of Conduct'?
e: 1. Core Concept: Fair Play in Politics. \n2. Logic: ECI election ke waqt rules banata hai taaki ruling party ka najaayaz fayda na ho. \n3. Extra Fact: MCC kanoon nahi hai, par ECI iska ullanghan karne par kadi saza de sakta hai.

qe: Article 151(1) says CAG report of the Union shall be submitted to:
e: 1. Core Concept: Reporting flow. \n2. Logic: Union ka sara data President ke paas jata hai audit ke baad. \n3. Extra Fact: Is report mein 'Appropriation' aur 'Finance' accounts hote hain.

qe: Who provides staff to the 'Regional Election Commissioners'?
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 324(6). \n2. Logic: Jab bhi ECI ya Regional commissioners maang karein, Centre ya State govt ko staff dena hoga. \n3. Extra Fact: Ye system resource bachane ke liye hai.

qe: The 'State Public Service Commission' members retire at what age?
e: 1. Core Concept: Retirement Age. \n2. Logic: Article 316(2) ke tehat SPSC ke liye 62 saal hai, par UPSC ke liye 65 saal. \n3. Extra Fact: Ise 41st Amendment (1976) se 60 se 62 kiya gaya tha.

qe: Which body is the 'Watchdog of Public Purse' in India?
e: 1. Core Concept: Guarding Taxpayer Money. \n2. Logic: CAG dekhta hai ki jo paisa Parliament ne diya tha, wo waisa hi kharch hua ya nahi. \n3. Extra Fact: CAG ko 'Officer of Parliament' bhi kaha jata hai audit ke maamle mein.

qe: Article 338A provides for the NCST. Does it investigate 'Forest Rights' issues?
e: 1. Core Concept: Wide Powers of Commission. \n2. Logic: STs ki zameen aur forest rights unki identity ka part hain, isliye NCST ispar nazar rakhta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Ye sarkar ko ST welfare par 'Report' bhi deta hai.

qe: The 'GST Council' was established by which Constitutional Amendment?
e: 1. Core Concept: Tax Reform. \n2. Logic: 101st Amendment (2016) ne pure desh mein ek tax system laya. \n3. Extra Fact: Isne Article 279A joda jo Council banata hai.

qe: Can the 'Election Commission' deregister a political party for violating MCC?
o: No (नहीं, उसके पास यह शक्ति नहीं है)
e: 1. Core Concept: Limitation of ECI power. \n2. Logic: ECI party register toh kar sakta hai, par register se HATA (deregister) nahi sakta jab tak koi thos kanooni wajah na ho. \n3. Extra Fact: Ye behes aksar news mein rehti hai.

qe: Which Article allows the President to appoint a 'Commission for Backward Classes'?
e: 1. Core Concept: Investigation of OBCs. \n2. Logic: Is Article ke tehat President 'Mandal Commission' jaise groups banata hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Ab NCBC (338B) ek permanent body ban gayi hai.

qe: Who is the 'Highest Law Officer' in a State in Bihar?
e: 1. Core Concept: State Legal Head. \n2. Logic: Article 165 ke tehat Advocate General sarkar ka vakeel hota hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Use Bihar Vidhan Sabha mein bolne ka haq hai.

qe: The 'Finance Commission' can make recommendations for 'Panchayats' under which Article?
e: 1. Core Concept: Strengthening Local Govt. \n2. Logic: Ise 73rd Amendment ke baad joda gaya taaki Central FC states ko panchayato ke liye extra fund de sake. \n3. Extra Fact: Article 243-I 'State' Finance Commission ke liye hai.

qe: Can the 'UPSC' conduct exams for 'States' if requested by the Governor?
o: Yes, with President's approval (हाँ, राष्ट्रपति के अनुमोदन से)
e: 1. Core Concept: Inter-institutional help. \n2. Logic: Agar BPSC kaam nahi kar pa raha, toh Governor request karta hai aur President use authorize karta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Ye Article 315(4) mein diya gaya hai.

qe: The 'Election Commission' issues which card for voting?
e: 1. Core Concept: Electoral Photo Identity Card. \n2. Logic: 1993 se ECI ne photo wale voter ID cards shuru kiye taaki 'Bogus voting' ruke. \n3. Extra Fact: Ye ECI ki administrative power ka part hai.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Expenses' of SPSC being charged on State Fund?
e: 1. Core Concept: Independence. \n2. Logic: Iska matlab hai ki Assembly inka budget radd nahi kar sakti. \n3. Extra Fact: UPSC ke liye yahi rule Centre fund par hota hai.

qe: Who is the Chairman of the 'Inter-State Council' (Art 263)?
e: 1. Core Concept: Federal Coordination. \n2. Logic: States ke beech jhagde suljhane ke liye PM iski adhyakshta karta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Isme Bihar ke CM bhi member hote hain.

qe: Article 151 says CAG report of Union is laid before?
e: 1. Core Concept: Final accountability. \n2. Logic: President ise Parliament mein rakhwayega aur phir PAC use check karegi. \n3. Extra Fact: Audit process ka ye aakhri step hota hai.

qe: The 'Finance Commission' is formed for how many years?
e: 1. Core Concept: Periodic body. \n2. Logic: Har 5 saal mein naya data aur naya batwara zaroori hota hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Filhal 16th Finance Commission chal raha hai.

qe: Who appoints the 'State Election Commissioner' in Bihar?
e: 1. Core Concept: Local Appointment. \n2. Logic: Article 243K ke tehat Governor hi ise appoint karta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Use hatane ka tarika HC judge jaisa tough hota hai.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities'?
e: 1. Core Concept: Language Protection. \n2. Logic: Ise 7th Amendment se add kiya gaya taaki mother tongues bachi rahein. \n3. Extra Fact: Ye officer apni report President ko deta hai.

qe: The 'Election Commission' has became a multi-member body permanently in which year?
e: 1. Core Concept: Final Structure. \n2. Logic: 1993 ke baad se 1 CEC + 2 ECs ka system permanently chal raha hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Isse pehle ye zyadatar single-member tha.

qe: Article 150 gives power to prescribe 'Accounting Forms' to?
o: President on advice of CAG (CAG की सलाह पर राष्ट्रपति)
e: 1. Core Concept: Uniformity. \n2. Logic: CAG decide karta hai kaise records rakhe jayein aur President use force karta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Isse audit mein asani hoti hai.

qe: Who is the 'Custodian' of the purity of Elections in India?
e: 1. Core Concept: Democracy Shield. \n2. Logic: ECI hamesha 'Free and Fair' elections ensure karta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Ise Samvidhan ka 4th pillar bhi kaha jata hai.

qe: The 'Salary and Allowances' of UPSC members are same as?
o: Equal to Judge of Supreme Court (SC न्यायाधीश के बराबर)
e: 1. Core Concept: Independence and Status. \n2. Logic: UPSC ki dignity banaye rakhne ke liye use uncha status diya gaya hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Inka kharch Consolidated Fund par charged hota hai.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'National Commission for SCs'?
e: 1. Core Concept: Social Safety. \n2. Logic: Ye commission Dalito ke adhikaaro par nazar rakhta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: 65th Amendment se ise multi-member body banaya gaya tha.

qe: Which Constitutional body is called the 'Balancer of Fiscal Federalism'?
e: 1. Core Concept: Equitable Wealth Sharing. \n2. Logic: Ye Centre aur States ke beech tax aur grants ka balance banaye rakhta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Ye har 5 saal mein banaya jata hai.

qe: The 'Election Commission' conduct elections for 'MLCs' in Bihar. True or False?
e: 1. Core Concept: ECI Jurisdiction. \n2. Logic: ECI Parliament aur State Legislatures (dono houses) ke election karwata hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Sirf Panchayato ka election ECI nahi karwata.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Salary and Allowances' of BPSC members?
e: 1. Core Concept: Financial Protection. \n2. Logic: Inka kharch State Consolidated Fund par charged hota hai taaki koi pressure na rahe. \n3. Extra Fact: UPSC ke liye yahi rule Centre fund par hota hai.

qe: Which Constitutional body is referred to as the 'Officer of Parliament' during the audit process?
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: CAG report Parliament ko deta hai aur Public Accounts Committee (PAC) ke sath milkar kaam karta hai. \n2. Reason: Wo Executive (Sarkar) ke kharche check karke Legislature (Sansad) ko jawab deta hai, isliye use Sansad ka agent//officer mana jata hai.

qe: Can the 'Election Commission' of India exercise its power without a law made by Parliament?
o: Yes, under 'Plenary Powers' (हाँ, अनुच्छेद 324 के तहत 'पूर्ण शक्तियों' के साथ)
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: Article 324 itna powerful hai ki agar kisi situation par Parliament ne kanoon nahi banaya, toh ECI khud nirdesh (directions) de sakta hai. \n2. Technical Fact: Ise 'Mohinder Singh Gill Case' mein Supreme Court ne confirm kiya tha.

qe: The 'Finance Commission' is a 'Non-Permanent' body. What happens to its staff after the report?
o: They return to Finance Ministry//Parent Dept (वे अपने मूल विभाग//वित्त मंत्रालय वापस चले जाते हैं)
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: Finance Commission har 5 saal mein banta hai aur kaam khatam hote hi dissolve ho jata hai. \n2. Fact: Iska koi permanent secretariat nahi hota, staff Ministry se liya jata hai.

qe: What is the main difference between 'Removal' of CEC and other Election Commissioners?
o: CEC needs Parliament removal; Others can be removed by President on CEC advice (CEC को संसद द्वारा; अन्यों को CEC की सलाह पर राष्ट्रपति द्वारा)
CEC can be removed by PM
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: Samvidhan CEC ko SC Judge jaisa 'Shield' deta hai, par baaki do ECs ko nahi. \n2. Reason: Ye CEC ko Commission ka 'Boss' banane ke liye kiya gaya hai taaki internal discipline rahe.

qe: Article 338B (NCBC) was added in 2018. Does it mean OBC reservation was not there before?
o: No, reservation was there, only the 'Body' became Constitutional (आरक्षण पहले से था, केवल संस्था संवैधानिक बनी)
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: OBC reservation 1993 (Mandal Case) se hi hai. \n2. Fact: Pehle 'National Commission for Backward Classes' sirf ek kanooni (statutory) body thi, 102nd Amendment ne use Samvidhan mein jagah di.

qe: Under Article 319, can a 'Member' of UPSC become the 'Chairman' of a State PSC?
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: UPSC ka member retired hone ke baad kisi dusri Govt job mein nahi ja sakta, PAR wo SPSC ka Chairman ya UPSC ka hi Chairman ban sakta hai. \n2. Reason: Isse hierarchy maintain rehti hai aur career growth bhi.

qe: The 'National Commission for STs' (338A) has the power to investigate which specific Bihar tribe issues?
o: All STs of Bihar (बिहार की सभी अनुसूचित जनजातियां)
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: Commission ka jurisdiction poore India par hai. \n2. Bihar Context: Bihar mein Jharkhand alag hone ke baad ST population kam hai, par 'Santhal Pargana' se jude maamlo mein NCST active rehta hai.

qe: Who audits the 'Secret Service Expenditure' in India?
o: CAG with limited certificate from executive (CAG, कार्यपालिका के सीमित प्रमाण पत्र के साथ)
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: Raw ya IB jaise kharche sensitive hote hain. \n2. Fact: CAG inki detail nahi maang sakta, wo sirf administrative head ka 'Certificate' maan leta hai ki paisa kharch hua hai.

qe: Which Constitutional body has the power to 'Grant Recognition' to political parties?
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: ECI hi tay karta hai ki kaun si party 'National' hai aur kaun si 'State'. \n2. Power: Symbols (Chunav Chinh) allot karna bhi isi ki 'Quasi-Judicial' power hai.

qe: Article 165: Can the 'Advocate General' of Bihar participate in 'Joint Sittings' of Bihar Legislature?
o: Bihar has no Joint Sitting provision
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: Smart Catch! Samvidhan mein 'State Legislature' ke liye Joint Sitting ka koi pravdhan nahi hai (Sirf Parliament mein hota hai). \n2. Fact: Agar hota, toh AG part le sakta tha, par Bihar mein deadlock ke liye Joint Sitting nahi hoti.

qe: What is the 'Eligibility' to be a member of the Finance Commission?
o: Decided by Parliament by Law (संसद द्वारा कानून से निर्धारित)
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: Samvidhan qualification nahi batata, wo Sansad ko power deta hai qualification tay karne ki. \n2. Result: Finance Commission Act 1951 ke tehat qualifications tay ki gayi hain (Judge, Accounts, Finance, Economics experts).

qe: Can the 'UPSC' and 'SPSC' hold exams together?
o: Yes, for Joint State PSC (हाँ, संयुक्त राज्य लोक सेवा आयोग के लिए)
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: Article 315(2) ke tehat do states milkar ek 'Joint PSC' bana sakte hain. \n2. Fact: Iske members ko President appoint karta hai, Governor nahi.

qe: Who is the 'Official Interpreter' of the reports of CAG in Parliament?
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: CAG report deta hai, par use 'Decode' karke ghotale nikalne ka kaam PAC karti hai. \n2. Relation: Isliye CAG aur PAC ko 'Husband and Wife' ya 'Friend' kaha jata hai.

qe: Under Article 326, can a 'Non-citizen' vote in Indian elections?
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: Adult Suffrage sirf 'Citizens' ke liye hai. \n2. Condition: Iske alawa wo pagal (unsound mind) ya apradhi (criminal) nahi hona chahiye.

qe: Is the 'Attorney General' a 'Whole-time' counsel for the Government?
o: No, he can do private practice (नहीं, वह निजी वकालत कर सकता है)
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: AG sarkari naukar (Govt servant) nahi mana jata. \n2. Restriction: Wo private practice kar sakta hai, par sarkar ke khilaaf case nahi lad sakta.

qe: The 'Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities' (350B) submits report to?
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: Samvidhanik bodies seedha President ko report karti hain. \n2. Path: President use Parliament ke dono Houses mein rakhwayega.

qe: Can 'Election Commissioners' be re-appointed to other government offices?
o: Yes, there is no constitutional bar (हाँ, संविधान में कोई रोक नहीं है)
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: UPSC ya CAG ke ulta, ECI ke members par retirement ke baad dusri naukri karne par koi 'Constitutional Bar' nahi hai. \n2. Criticism: Ise ECI ki independence ke liye ek khatra mana jata hai.

qe: Which Article gives 'Constitutional Status' to the 'National Commission for SC'?
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: Article 17 untouchability khatam karta hai, par 'Body' 338 se banti hai. \n2. Link: Ye dono Articles milkar Dalito ke rights ko protect karte hain.

qe: Who decides the 'Rules of Service' for staff of the State PSC (BPSC)?
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: Article 318 ke tehat Governor ko ye power di gayi hai. \n2. Scope: Isme staff ki ginti aur unki salary ke rules shamil hain.

qe: Can the 'Finance Commission' recommend taxes for 'Municipalities'?
o: Yes, under Article 280(3)(c) (हाँ, अनुच्छेद 280(3)(c) के तहत)
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: 74th Amendment ke baad ye add kiya gaya. \n2. Job: Central Finance Commission state ko batata hai ki Municipalities ka fund kaise badhayein.

qe: The 'Finance Commission' can be re-constituted before 5 years. True or False?
e: 1. Core Concept: Flexibility. \n2. Logic: Article 280 kehta hai 'at the expiration of every 5th year or earlier'. \n3. Extra Fact: Agar President ko lage toh wo 3 ya 4 saal mein bhi naya commission bana sakta hai.

qe: Which Article of the Constitution establishes the 'Election Commission' of India?
e: 1. Core Concept: Apex Body for Elections. \n2. Logic: Article 324 ECI ko poore desh mein Parliament, State Assemblies, President aur VP ke elections karwane ki 'Sovereign' power deta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Ye poore India ke liye ek hi central body hai.

qe: The CAG of India can be removed from his office in 'like manner' as?
o: A Judge of the Supreme Court (सुप्रीम कोर्ट के न्यायाधीश की तरह)
e: 1. Core Concept: Security of Tenure. \n2. Logic: CAG ko hatana aasan nahi hai. Use sirf Parliament ke dono houses mein 'Special Majority' pass karke hi hataya ja sakta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Article 148 ke tehat ye provision uski independence bachane ke liye hai.

qe: Who is the Chairman of the 'Finance Commission'?
o: A person having experience in Public Affairs (सार्वजनिक मामलों का अनुभव रखने वाला व्यक्ति)
e: 1. Core Concept: Eligibility Criteria. \n2. Logic: Samvidhan ke tehat Chairman 'Public Affairs' ka expert hona chahiye, aur baaki 4 members technical knowledge wale hone chahiye. \n3. Extra Fact: Inka chunaav President dwara har 5 saal mein kiya jata hai.

qe: Under Article 338A, which body was created for the welfare of STs?
o: National Commission for ST (राष्ट्रीय अनुसूचित जनजाति आयोग)
e: 1. Core Concept: Specialized Protection. \n2. Logic: 89th Amendment (2003) se SC aur ST commission ko alag kar diya gaya tha taaki STs par zyada focus ho sake. \n3. Extra Fact: Isme ek Chairman, ek VC aur 3 members hote hain.

qe: The 'Union Public Service Commission' (UPSC) is which type of body?
e: 1. Core Concept: Direct Source from Constitution. \n2. Logic: Chunki Article 315 seedha UPSC banane ka nirdesh deta hai, isliye ye Constitutional body hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Ye Central Recruitment agency hai jo 'All India Services' chun-ti hai.

qe: Who acts as the 'Advisory Body' to the President for the disqualification of a Member of Parliament?
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 103. \n2. Logic: Agar kisi MP ki 'Qualification' par sawal uthe (except defection), toh President ko ECI ki rai leni padti hai aur wo rai 'Binding' hoti hai. \n3. Extra Fact: ECI election disputes mein semi-judicial role nibhata hai.

qe: Which Constitutional Body is known as the 'Highest Law Officer' in India?
e: 1. Core Concept: Government's Counsel. \n2. Logic: Article 76 ke tehat AG sarkar ko kanooni rai deta hai aur kisi bhi court mein sarkar ka paksh rakhta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Wo Parliament ki proceedings mein bol sakta hai par vote nahi de sakta.

qe: The 'Advocate General' of Bihar is appointed by:
e: 1. Core Concept: State Law Officer. \n2. Logic: Article 165 ke tehat Governor hi ise appoint karta hai aur wo Governor ki marzi (pleasure) tak pad par rehta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Iski qualification ek HC judge ke barabar honi chahiye.

qe: Which Article provides for 'Audit of Accounts of States' by the CAG?
e: 1. Core Concept: Scope of Audit. \n2. Logic: 148 post banata hai, par 149 kehta hai ki CAG Centre aur States dono ke accounts ki jaanch karega. \n3. Extra Fact: Ye India ki 'Integrated' audit system ko darshata hai.

qe: The 'Election Commission' has became a permanent multi-member body from which year?
e: 1. Core Concept: Structural Evolution. \n2. Logic: Pehle ye single-member tha, par workload badhne par ise 1993 se 3-member (1 CEC + 2 ECs) kar diya gaya. \n3. Extra Fact: Teeno commissioners ki power aur salary barabar hoti hai.

qe: Under Article 317, the removal of a UPSC member can be done after an inquiry by:
e: 1. Core Concept: Judicial Oversight. \n2. Logic: President misbehaviour ke liye seedha nahi hata sakta, pehle SC jaanch karega aur report dega. \n3. Extra Fact: Agar SC 'Insolvency' (diwaliya) paye, toh President bina jaanch ke bhi hata sakta hai.

qe: Which body is responsible for 'Delimitation' of constituencies every few years?
e: 1. Core Concept: Redrawing Boundaries. \n2. Logic: Ise President banate hain aur iska head retired judge hota hai. ECI iske sath milkar kaam karta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Iske order ko kisi bhi court mein challenge nahi kiya ja sakta.

qe: Article 151 deals with which function of the CAG?
e: 1. Core Concept: Final Reporting. \n2. Logic: CAG apni audit report President ko deta hai (Centre ke liye) aur Governor ko (State ke liye). \n3. Extra Fact: Ye report baad mein Public Accounts Committee check karti hai.

qe: Who determines the 'number of members' in the State Public Service Commission (BPSC)?
e: 1. Core Concept: State Autonomy. \n2. Logic: Article 318 ke tehat ye power Governor ke paas hai. \n3. Extra Fact: UPSC ke liye yahi power President ke paas hoti hai.

qe: Can the 'Election Commission' disqualify an MLA for 'Office of Profit'?
o: Only with Governor's order after ECI advice (ECI की सलाह पर राज्यपाल के आदेश से)
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 192. \n2. Logic: Governor ko ECI ki rai leni padti hai aur wo 'Binding' hoti hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Ye power Governor ke naam par execute hoti hai.

qe: Which Amendment added the 'National Commission for OBC' to the Constitution?
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 338B. \n2. Logic: 2018 mein 102nd Amendment se NCBC ko constitutional body banaya gaya. \n3. Extra Fact: Isne SC aur ST commission ki tarah hi powers payi hain.

qe: Who decides the 'Rules' for staff recruitment in the Election Commission?
e: 1. Core Concept: Administrative Control. \n2. Logic: Article 324(5) ke tehat President hi inki service conditions aur rules banata hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Halanki kaam karte waqt wo ECI ke under rehte hain.

qe: Is the 'Finance Commission' recommendations binding on the Government?
o: No, they are only advisory (नहीं, वे केवल सलाहकारी हैं)
e: 1. Core Concept: Non-binding Nature. \n2. Logic: Sarkar ise manne ke liye kanoonan majboor nahi hai, par tradition hai ki ise mana jata hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Iska role tax sharing mein 'Neutral Judge' jaisa hota hai.

qe: The 'Joint State Public Service Commission' (JSPSC) is which type of body?
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 315(2). \n2. Logic: Halanki UPSC aur SPSC constitutional hain, par JSPSC Parliament ke kanoon (Act) se banta hai, isliye ye Statutory hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Do states milkar ise banwa sakte hain.

qe: Who is the 'Custodian of Public Purse' at the State level?
e: 1. Core Concept: Uniformity in Audit. \n2. Logic: CAG akela aisa adhikari hai jo Centre aur State dono ke kharche check karta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Bihar sarkar ka audit bhi CAG ki team hi karti hai.

qe: The 'Salary and Allowances' of the CEC are same as?
o: Judge of the Supreme Court (सुप्रीम कोर्ट के न्यायाधीश)
e: 1. Core Concept: Rank and Status. \n2. Logic: ECI ki independence ke liye use SC judge ke barabar suvidhayein di gayi hain. \n3. Extra Fact: Use hatane ka tarika bhi SC judge jaisa hi hai.

qe: Article 150 gives the power to prescribe the 'Form of Accounts' to?
o: President on advice of CAG (CAG की सलाह पर राष्ट्रपति)
e: 1. Core Concept: Administrative Power. \n2. Logic: CAG batata hai ki accounts kaise banein aur President use order deta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Ye data transparency ke liye zaroori hai.

qe: Which Constitutional body identifies 'Backward Classes' for reservation under Article 340?
e: 1. Core Concept: OBC status. \n2. Logic: President is Article ke tehat commission banate hain (jaise Mandal Commission). \n3. Extra Fact: Ab Article 338B (NCBC) ise permanently handle karta hai.

qe: Can a person who was a 'Member' of BPSC become Chairman of UPSC?
e: 1. Core Concept: Post-retirement growth. \n2. Logic: Article 319 ke tehat SPSC member UPSC ka Chairman ya member ban sakta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Par wo kisi dusri 'Normal Govt job' mein nahi ja sakta.

qe: Article 280 requires the Finance Commission to recommend 'Grants-in-aid' to?
e: 1. Core Concept: Revenue distribution. \n2. Logic: Tax sharing ke alawa sarkar jo extra paisa states ko deti hai, wo bhi FC tay karta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Isse pichde states (jaise Bihar) ko madad milti hai.

qe: Who provides the 'Staff' to the State Election Commission in Bihar?
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 243K(3). \n2. Logic: Panchayato ke election ke liye Governor hi SEC ko zaroori staff deta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Ye local body elections ke liye zaroori hai.

qe: Which Article prohibits 'Discrimination' in inclusion in Electoral Rolls?
e: 1. Core Concept: Secular Elections. \n2. Logic: Kisi ko dharam ya jaati ke adhar par vote dene se nahi roka ja sakta. \n3. Extra Fact: Article 326 'Right to Vote' (Age base) deta hai.

qe: Can the 'Attorney General' speak in both Houses of Parliament?
e: 1. Core Concept: Special Privileges. \n2. Logic: Article 88 ke tehat AG sadasya nahi hote hue bhi dono Houses mein baith sakta aur bol sakta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Wo kisi Parliamentary committee ka member bhi ban sakta hai.

qe: The 'Expenses' of the UPSC are charged on which fund?
o: Consolidated Fund of India (भारत की संचित निधि)
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 322. \n2. Logic: UPSC ke kharche par Parliament mein vote nahi hota taaki wo bina pressure ke kaam karein. \n3. Extra Fact: SPSC (BPSC) ka kharch State fund par charged hota hai.

qe: What is the rank of 'CAG' in the Table of Precedence?
o: Equal to Judge of Supreme Court (SC न्यायाधीश के बराबर)
e: 1. Core Concept: Protocol status. \n2. Logic: CAG ka pad bahut uncha mana jata hai (Rank 9). \n3. Extra Fact: CJI ka rank 6 hai.

qe: The 'Election Commission' has became multi-member in?
e: 1. Core Concept: History. \n2. Logic: Pehli baar 1989 mein age limit 21 se 18 hone par workload badha, tab ise 3 member kiya gaya. \n3. Extra Fact: Permanently ye 1993 se multi-member hai.

qe: Under Article 324, who appoints 'Regional Commissioners'?
e: 1. Core Concept: Expansion during elections. \n2. Logic: President hi ECI se pich kar elections ke waqt help ke liye Regional Commissioners appoint karta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Inka tenure President tay karta hai.

qe: Who acts as the 'Advisory' on MLC election disputes in Bihar?
e: 1. Core Concept: ECI Jurisdiction. \n2. Logic: Vidhan Parishad (MLC) ke elections bhi ECI hi karwata hai, isliye wahi decide karta hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Article 324 ye poori power deta hai.

qe: Which Article provides for 'Special Officer for STs' (before separate commission)?
e: 1. Core Concept: History of Commissions. \n2. Logic: Pehle 338 mein hi SC aur ST dono ka officer hota tha. \n3. Extra Fact: Ab 338A ST ke liye bilkul alag hai.

qe: Who decides the 'Tenure' of the Regional Election Commissioners?
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 324(5). \n2. Logic: Samvidhan ne ye shakti President ko di hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Ye commissioners sirf elections ke waqt help ke liye aate hain.

qe: What is the main power of 'Advocate General' in Bihar legislature?
o: To speak and participate (बोलना और भाग लेना)
e: 1. Core Concept: Privilege of Non-member. \n2. Logic: Wo sadasya nahi hai par use bolne aur baithne ka haq hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Wo vote nahi de sakta (Art 177).

qe: The 'National Commission for OBC' was formed as a Statutory body in?
e: 1. Core Concept: History of NCBC. \n2. Logic: SC ke order ke baad 1993 mein kanoon banakar ise pehli baar banaya gaya. \n3. Extra Fact: Constitutional status ise 2018 mein mila.

qe: Who acts as the 'Election Commission' for J&K elections currently?
e: 1. Core Concept: Uniformity. \n2. Logic: Article 370 hatne ke baad ab saare bade elections ECI hi karwata hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Panchayato ka election SEC hi karwata hai.

qe: Which Article deals with 'All India Services' (IAS
e: 1. Core Concept: Federal Services. \n2. Logic: Rajya Sabha agar 2//3 bahumat se pass kare, toh Sansad nayi service bana sakti hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Filhal IAS, IPS aur IFoS hi All India Services hain.

qe: Who is the 'Highest Law Officer' in India?
e: 1. Core Concept: Apex Law Post. \n2. Logic: Article 76 ke tehat AG hi desh ka sabse bada vakeel hai. \n3. Extra Fact: Use wahi qualification chahiye jo ek SC judge ko.

qe: The 'Election Commission' can remove 'CEC' only by?
o: Parliamentary process like SC Judge (SC जज की तरह संसदीय प्रक्रिया)
e: 1. Core Concept: Security of CEC. \n2. Logic: Use hatana bahut mushkil hai taaki wo bina dar ke kaam kare. \n3. Extra Fact: Baaki ECs ko CEC ki sifaarish par President hata sakta hai.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'UPSC' and 'SPSC'?
e: 1. Core Concept: Founding Articles. \n2. Logic: Article 315 mukhya base hai recruitement commissions ka. \n3. Extra Fact: Inka kaam merit-based selection hai.

qe: The 'Finance Commission' report is submitted to?
e: 1. Core Concept: Constitutional Procedure. \n2. Logic: Article 281 ke tehat President ise dono houses mein rakhwayega. \n3. Extra Fact: Iske sath 'Action Taken Report' bhi lagti hai.

qe: Under which Article can the President remove a member of the Public Service Commission?
qh: किस अनुच्छेद के तहत राष्ट्रपति लोक सेवा आयोग के सदस्य को हटा सकते हैं?
e: 1. Core Concept: Removal Process. \\n2. Logic: Appointment 316 mein hai, par hatane ki prakriya 317 mein hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: 'Misbehaviour' ke case mein Supreme Court ki inquiry report binding hoti hai, par 'Insolvency' (diwaliya hona) ya 'Paid employment' ke liye President bina inquiry ke bhi hata sakta hai.

qe: The 'Consolidated Fund of India' is audited by CAG under which Article?
qh: CAG किस अनुच्छेद के तहत भारत की संचित निधि का ऑडिट करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Duties of CAG. \\n2. Logic: 148 sirf pad (post) banata hai, par uski shaktiyan (powers) aur kartavya 149 mein likhe hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: CAG ko 'Friend, Philosopher and Guide' of Public Accounts Committee kaha jata hai.

qe: Who acts as the 'Election Commission' for Panchayats and Municipalities?
qh: पंचायतों और नगर पालिकाओं के लिए 'निर्वाचन आयोग' के रूप में कौन कार्य करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Local Elections. \\n2. Logic: Article 243K ke tehat State Election Commission (SEC) banaya gaya hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: SEC ka commissioner Governor dwara appoint hota hai par use hatane ka tarika High Court judge jaisa (Parliament dwara) hota hai.

qe: The 'Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities' was not in the original Constitution. It was added by:
qh: 'भाषाई अल्पसंख्यकों के लिए विशेष अधिकारी' मूल संविधान में नहीं था। इसे किसके द्वारा जोड़ा गया?
e: 1. Core Concept: Protecting Minority Languages. \\n2. Logic: States Reorganisation Act ke baad bhashayi vivad badhe, isliye Article 350B joda gaya. \\n3. Extra Fact: Iska headquarter 'Prayagraj' (Allahabad) mein hai.

qe: What is the 'Quorum' for the meeting of the GST Council?
qh: GST परिषद की बैठक के लिए 'कोरम' क्या है?
o: 1/2 of total members (कुल सदस्यों का आधा)
e: 1. Core Concept: Deciding Power. \\n2. Logic: Kam se kam 50% sadasyo ka hona zaroori hai tabhi meeting valid hogi. \\n3. Extra Fact: GST Council mein voting power mein States ka 2/3 aur Centre ka 1/3 hissa hota hai.

qe: Which Constitutional Body has the power to regulate its own procedure?
qh: किस संवैधानिक निकाय के पास अपनी प्रक्रिया को विनियमित करने की शक्ति है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Autonomy. \\n2. Logic: In bodies ko independence dene ke liye Samvidhan unhe apne rules khud banane ki azadi deta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: NCST (Art 338A) ke paas Civil Court ki powers hoti hain.

qe: Who determines the 'Strength' of the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)?
qh: UPSC की 'सदस्य संख्या' कौन निर्धारित करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Variable Structure. \\n2. Logic: Samvidhan mein sankhya fix nahi hai. President apni marzi se ise tay karta hai (Zyadatar 9 se 11 member hote hain). \\n3. Extra Fact: Members ka tenure 6 saal ya 65 age hota hai.

qe: Can the 'Attorney General' be a member of a Parliamentary Committee?
qh: क्या महान्यायवादी संसदीय समिति का सदस्य हो सकता है?
o: Only if he is an MP
e: 1. Core Concept: Parliamentary Privileges. \\n2. Logic: Article 88 ke tehat wo kisi bhi committee ka member ban sakta hai aur bol sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Wo sirf 'Vote' nahi de sakta.

qe: The 'National Commission for STs' (NCST) submits its report to:
qh: 'राष्ट्रीय अनुसूचित जनजाति आयोग' अपनी रिपोर्ट किसे सौंपता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Reporting Hierarchy. \\n2. Logic: Saari badi Constitutional bodies apni report President ko hi deti hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: President is report ko Parliament mein rakhwate hain.

qe: Which Article allows 'Joint State Public Service Commission' to be created?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद 'संयुक्त राज्य लोक सेवा आयोग' बनाने की अनुमति देता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Shared Recruitment. \\n2. Logic: Agar do ya zyada states (jaise Bihar-Jharkhand) request karein, toh Sansad kanoon banakar JSPSC bana sakti hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: JSPSC ke members ko Governor nahi balki 'President' appoint karta hai.

qe: Who provides the 'Staff' to the Election Commission for conducting elections?
qh: चुनाव कराने के लिए चुनाव आयोग को 'कर्मचारी' कौन उपलब्ध कराता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Resource management. \\n2. Logic: Article 324(6) ke tehat jab ECI maang kare, toh President ya Governor ko staff dena hi padega. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isi liye teachers aur govt employees ki duty lagti hai.

qe: What is the status of 'Advocate General' when the State Government resigns?
qh: जब राज्य सरकार इस्तीफा देती है तो 'महाधिवक्ता' की स्थिति क्या होती है?
o: He usually resigns (आमतौर पर वह इस्तीफा दे देता है)
e: 1. Core Concept: Political Convention. \\n2. Logic: Chunki wo sarkar ka vakeel hai aur sarkar ki sifaarish par aaya hai, isliye ethics ke hisab se use bhi hat jana chahiye. \\n3. Extra Fact: Article 165 mein unka tenure fix nahi hai.

qe: The 'Finance Commission' is a 'Quasi-Judicial' body. Why?
qh: वित्त आयोग एक 'अर्ध-न्यायिक' निकाय है। क्यों?
o: It has powers of a civil court to summon people (समन करने के लिए इसके पास सिविल कोर्ट की शक्तियां हैं)
e: 1. Core Concept: Investigating Power. \\n2. Logic: Data lene ke liye ye kisi bhi officer ko bula sakta hai aur documents mangwa sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Iska mukhya kaam tax sharing ka blueprint banana hai.

qe: Which Article deals with the 'Audit of Accounts of States' by CAG?
qh: CAG द्वारा 'राज्यों के खातों के ऑडिट' से संबंधित कौन सा अनुच्छेद है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Uniform Audit System. \\n2. Logic: 149 CAG ki powers define karta hai jisme State audit bhi shamil hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: CAG apni state report 'Governor' ko deta hai (Art 151(2)).

qe: Can the 'Election Commission' disqualify an MP for 'Corrupt Practices'?
qh: क्या चुनाव आयोग 'भ्रष्ट आचरण' के लिए सांसद को अयोग्य घोषित कर सकता है?
o: Only with President's order after ECI advice (ECI की सलाह पर राष्ट्रपति के आदेश से)
e: 1. Core Concept: Advisory role. \\n2. Logic: RPA 1951 ke tehat ECI apni rai President ko deta hai aur President use manne ke liye majboor hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: 'Office of Profit' mein bhi yahi process chalti hai.

qe: Article 338B deals with NCBC. When was it added to the Constitution?
qh: NCBC से संबंधित अनुच्छेद 338B को संविधान में कब जोड़ा गया?
e: 1. Core Concept: Constitutional Status to OBC. \\n2. Logic: Pehle ye sirf ek statutory body thi. 102nd Amendment se ise Samvidhanik darja mila. \\n3. Extra Fact: Iska structure SC aur ST commission jaisa hi hai.

qe: Who determines the 'Qualifications' of the Finance Commission members?
qh: वित्त आयोग के सदस्यों की 'योग्यता' कौन निर्धारित करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Legislative Control. \\n2. Logic: Samvidhan ne ye power Sansad ko di hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Parliament ne 'Finance Commission Act, 1951' ke tehat qualifications tay ki hain.

qe: The 'Union Public Service Commission' can serve the needs of a State if:
qh: UPSC किसी राज्य की आवश्यकताओं को पूरा कर सकता है यदि:
o: Governor requests with President's approval (राष्ट्रपति के अनुमोदन से राज्यपाल अनुरोध करे)
e: 1. Core Concept: Assistance to States. \\n2. Logic: Agar BPSC kaam nahi kar pa raha, toh Governor request karke UPSC se exam karwa sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Iske liye President ki permission 'Mandatory' (zaroori) hai.

qe: Which body is responsible for 'Delimitation' (boundary marking) of constituencies?
qh: निर्वाचन क्षेत्रों के 'परिसीमन' के लिए कौन सा निकाय जिम्मेदार है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Redrawing Map. \\n2. Logic: Ise President banate hain aur ye ECI ke sath milkar kaam karta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Iske order ko kisi bhi court mein challenge nahi kiya ja sakta.

qe: Article 148 says CAG shall be appointed by President. What is his 'Oath' similar to?
qh: अनुच्छेद 148 कहता है CAG की नियुक्ति राष्ट्रपति करेगा। उसकी 'शपथ' किसके समान है?
o: Judge of Supreme Court (SC के न्यायाधीश)
e: 1. Core Concept: Status of CAG. \\n2. Logic: CAG ka pad SC judge ke barabar ka hota hai, isliye shapath bhi waisi hi hoti hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Use hatane ka tarika bhi SC judge jaisa hi hai.

qe: Who decides the 'Rules' for the recruitment of staff in the Election Commission?
qh: चुनाव आयोग में कर्मचारियों की भर्ती के नियम कौन तय करता है?
o: President after consulting ECI (ECI से परामर्श के बाद राष्ट्रपति)
e: 1. Core Concept: Administrative Rules. \\n2. Logic: Article 324(5) ke tehat President hi ye rules banata hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Inki conditions of service bhi President hi tay karta hai.

qe: What is the 'Voting Power' of the Central Government in the GST Council?
qh: GST परिषद में केंद्र सरकार की 'मतदान शक्ति' क्या है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Federal Decision Making. \\n2. Logic: Centre ke paas 1/3 power hai aur saari States ke paas milkar 2/3. \\n3. Extra Fact: Koi bhi faisla 3/4th majority se hi pass hota hai.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Appointment of Advocate General' in Bihar?
qh: बिहार में 'महाधिवक्ता की नियुक्ति' का प्रावधान कौन सा अनुच्छेद करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: State Law Officer. \\n2. Logic: 76 Centre (AG) ke liye hai, 165 State (Advocate General) ke liye. \\n3. Extra Fact: Wo Bihar Vidhan Sabha ki proceedings mein bol sakta hai.

qe: The 'Expenses' of the State Public Service Commission (BPSC) are charged on?
qh: BPSC के 'खर्च' किस पर भारित होते हैं?
o: Consolidated Fund of the State (राज्य की संचित निधि)
e: 1. Core Concept: Financial Autonomy. \\n2. Logic: Article 322 ke tehat BPSC ka kharch Bihar ki fund se ayega aur ispar voting nahi hogi. \\n3. Extra Fact: UPSC ka kharch Centre ki fund se aata hai.

qe: Can a person who was a member of UPSC become 'Chairman' of a State PSC?
qh: क्या UPSC का सदस्य किसी राज्य PSC का 'अध्यक्ष' बन सकता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Post-retirement eligibility. \\n2. Logic: Article 319 ke tehat UPSC member kisi SPSC ka Chairman ya UPSC ka hi Chairman ban sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Par wo kisi dusri 'Govt job' mein nahi ja sakta.

qe: Which Article prohibits 'Discrimination' in inclusion in electoral rolls?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद मतदाता सूची में शामिल करने में 'भेदभाव' को रोकता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Universal Voter Roll. \\n2. Logic: Dharam, jaati ya ling ke adhar par kisi ko vote dene se roka nahi ja sakta. \\n3. Extra Fact: Article 326 'Adult Suffrage' (18 saal se upar vote) ki baat karta hai.

qe: Who is the 'Highest Law Officer' in a State?
qh: राज्य में 'उच्चतम कानून अधिकारी' कौन होता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Legal Hierarchy. \\n2. Logic: Article 165 ke tehat Advocate General hi state ka boss vakeel hota hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Iski qualification ek HC judge ke barabar honi chahiye.

qe: The 'Finance Commission' report is submitted to Parliament by?
qh: वित्त आयोग की रिपोर्ट संसद में किसके द्वारा पेश की जाती है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Constitutional process. \\n2. Logic: Commission report President ko deta hai, aur President use dono Houses ke samne rakhwata hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Iske sath 'Action Taken Report' bhi hoti hai.

qe: How many members are there in the 'Election Commission' currently?
qh: वर्तमान में चुनाव आयोग में कितने सदस्य हैं?
e: 1. Core Concept: Commission Size. \\n2. Logic: 1993 ke baad se ye hamesha 3-member body rahi hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Faisle hamesha 'Majority' se liye jate hain, CEC ke paas Veto nahi hota.

qe: Which Article allows the President to appoint 'Special Officer for SCs'?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद राष्ट्रपति को SCs के लिए 'विशेष अधिकारी' नियुक्त करने की अनुमति देता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Institutional Evolution. \\n2. Logic: Pehle sirf ek officer hota tha, jo baad mein 65th Amendment se 'Commission' ban gaya. \\n3. Extra Fact: Aaj ise National Commission for SC kehte hain.

qe: The 'Chairman of UPSC' can be re-appointed for a second term. True or False?
qh: UPSC का अध्यक्ष दूसरे कार्यकाल के लिए फिर से नियुक्त किया जा सकता है। सही या गलत?
e: 1. Core Concept: Independence of UPSC. \\n2. Logic: Article 319 kehta hai ki wo dobara us pad par nahi baith sakta taaki wo sarkar ko khush karne ki koshish na kare. \\n3. Extra Fact: Wo India ya State Govt mein koi aur naukri bhi nahi kar sakta.

qe: Who decides the 'Number of Members' in a State Public Service Commission?
qh: राज्य लोक सेवा आयोग (BPSC) में सदस्यों की संख्या कौन तय करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: State Control. \\n2. Logic: Article 318 ke tehat ye power Governor ke paas hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: UPSC ke liye ye power President ke paas hai.

qe: The 'Election Commission' conducts the elections for 'Member of Legislative Council' (MLC) in Bihar.
qh: बिहार में 'विधान परिषद सदस्य' (MLC) का चुनाव चुनाव आयोग कराता है।
e: 1. Core Concept: ECI Jurisdiction. \\n2. Logic: ECI Parliament aur State Legislatures (dono houses) ke election karwata hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Sirf Panchayato ka election ECI nahi karwata.

qe: Article 151 deals with:
qh: अनुच्छेद 151 किससे संबंधित है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Reporting. \\n2. Logic: CAG apni audit reports President (Union ke liye) aur Governor (State ke liye) ko deta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye reports PAC check karti hai.

qe: Who is the Chairman of the 'Inter-State Council'?
qh: 'अंतर-राज्य परिषद' का अध्यक्ष कौन होता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 263. \\n2. Logic: States ke beech coordination ke liye PM iski adhyakshta karte hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isme saare States ke CM member hote hain.

qe: The 'Finance Commission' can make recommendations on the distribution of:
qh: वित्त आयोग किसके वितरण पर सिफारिशें दे सकता है?
o: Grants-in-aid to states (राज्यों को सहायता अनुदान)
Both A and B (A और B दोनों)
e: 1. Core Concept: Revenue distribution. \\n2. Logic: Tax ke alawa sarkar states ko jo extra paisa (grants) deti hai, wo bhi FC hi tay karta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Article 275 ke tehat grants di jati hain.

qe: Under Article 324, who has the power of 'Superintendence, direction and control' of elections?
qh: अनुच्छेद 324 के तहत चुनावों के 'अधीक्षण, निर्देशन और नियंत्रण' की शक्ति किसके पास है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Apex Election Body. \\n2. Logic: In teen shabdo ne ECI ko kisi bhi illegal practice ko rokne ki poori power di hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise 'Plenary Power' bhi kehte hain.

qe: What is the 'Age Limit' for the members of UPSC?
qh: UPSC के सदस्यों के लिए 'आयु सीमा' क्या है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Tenure. \\n2. Logic: Article 316 ke tehat 6 saal ya 65 saal (jo bhi pehle ho). \\n3. Extra Fact: SPSC (BPSC) ke liye ye limit 62 saal hai.

qe: The 'Advocate General' has the right to vote in the proceedings of State Legislature.
qh: महाधिवक्ता को राज्य विधानमंडल की कार्यवाही में वोट देने का अधिकार है।
e: 1. Core Concept: Member rights vs Non-member. \\n2. Logic: Wo sadasya nahi hai, isliye bol sakta hai par vote nahi de sakta. \\n3. Extra Fact: Attorney General ke liye bhi yahi rule Sansad mein hai.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'National Commission for STs' (NCST)?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद 'राष्ट्रीय अनुसूचित जनजाति आयोग' (NCST) का प्रावधान करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Separate ST Body. \\n2. Logic: Ise 89th Amendment (2003) se add kiya gaya. \\n3. Extra Fact: 338 SC ke liye hai aur 338B OBC ke liye.

qe: Who appoints the 'Chairman' of the Finance Commission?
qh: वित्त आयोग के 'अध्यक्ष' की नियुक्ति कौन करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Appointment of Commissions. \\n2. Logic: Article 280 ke tehat President hi Commission banata hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Filhal 16th Finance Commission chal raha hai (Arvind Panagariya is Chairman).

qe: Can the 'Election Commissioners' be removed from office like the CEC?
qh: क्या चुनाव आयुक्तों को CEC की तरह हटाया जा सकता है?
o: No, only on recommendation of CEC (नहीं, केवल CEC की सिफारिश पर)
e: 1. Core Concept: Removal differences. \\n2. Logic: CEC ko SC judge ki tarah hataya jata hai, par baaki 2 ECs ko President hata sakta hai CEC se puch kar. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye CEC ki leadership ko mazboot banata hai.

qe: The 'Union Public Service Commission' is which type of body?
qh: UPSC किस प्रकार का निकाय है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 315. \\n2. Logic: Ise seedha Samvidhan ne banaya hai, isliye ye Constitutional hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise 'Watchdog of Merit System' kaha jata hai.

qe: Which Constitutional Body provides for the 'Delimitation of Constituencies'?
qh: कौन सा संवैधानिक निकाय निर्वाचन क्षेत्रों के 'परिसीमन' का प्रावधान करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Collaborative effort. \\n2. Logic: Sansad kanoon banati hai (Art 82) aur ECI use implement karwata hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Delimitation Commission ka head hamesha ek retired SC judge hota hai.

qe: Who appoints the 'Advocate General' of Bihar?
qh: बिहार के 'महाधिवक्ता' की नियुक्ति कौन करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: State appointments. \\n2. Logic: Article 165 ke tehat Governor hi ise appoint karta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Wo Governor ke 'Pleasure' tak hi pad par rehta hai.

qe: Article 338 deals with National Commission for SC. Does it also handle 'Anglo-Indians'?
qh: अनुच्छेद 338 SC आयोग से संबंधित है। क्या यह 'एंग्लो-इंडियंस' को भी संभालता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Extended Jurisdiction. \\n2. Logic: Article 338(10) ke tehat SC Commission hi Anglo-Indian community ke rights ki jaanch karta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Halanki 104th Amendment ne Anglo-Indians ka reservation khatam kar diya hai.

qe: Can the 'Comptroller and Auditor General' be a member of Parliament?
qh: क्या CAG संसद का सदस्य हो सकता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Office of Profit. \\n2. Logic: CAG ki independence ke liye use legislature aur executive se alag rakha gaya hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Wo retirement ke baad koi govt job bhi nahi le sakta.

qe: Which Article provides for 'Adult Suffrage' (Right to vote)?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद 'वयस्क मताधिकार' (वोट देने का अधिकार) प्रदान करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Democratic right. \\n2. Logic: 18 saal se upar har nagrik ko vote dene ka haq hai jab tak kanoon ne use mana na kiya ho. \\n3. Extra Fact: 61st Amendment ne age 21 se 18 ki thi.

qe: Which Article of the Constitution gives the CAG the power to audit the 'Contingency Fund' of India?
qh: कौन सा अनुच्छेद CAG को भारत की 'आकस्मिकता निधि' के ऑडिट की शक्ति देता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Audit Power. \\n2. Logic: Article 149 CAG ki saari powers aur duties define karta hai, jisme Consolidated, Contingency aur Public Account teeno ka audit shamil hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: CAG 'Local Bodies' (Panchayat) ka audit tabhi karta hai jab Governor ya President request karein.

qe: Can the 'Election Commission' of India postpone an election due to 'Natural Calamity'?
qh: क्या भारत का चुनाव आयोग 'प्राकृतिक आपदा' के कारण चुनाव स्थगित कर सकता है?
o: Yes, under Article 324 (हाँ, अनुच्छेद 324 के तहत)
e: 1. Core Concept: Plenary Powers. \\n2. Logic: Article 324 mein 'Superintendence' word itna wide hai ki ECI unfair ya mushkil halat mein election rok sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: COVID-19 ke waqt isi power ka use karke elections aur by-elections ko postpone kiya gaya tha.

qe: Who determines the 'number of members' in the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)?
qh: UPSC में 'सदस्यों की संख्या' कौन निर्धारित करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Variable Structure. \\n2. Logic: Samvidhan mein UPSC ki strength fix nahi hai, ye President ke vivek (discretion) par chhoda gaya hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Zyadatar isme Chairman samet 9 se 11 sadasya hote hain.

qe: Under Article 338, who has the power of a 'Civil Court' while investigating a case?
qh: अनुच्छेद 338 के तहत, मामले की जांच करते समय किसके पास 'सिविल कोर्ट' की शक्ति होती है?
o: National Commission for SC (राष्ट्रीय अनुसूचित जाति आयोग)
e: 1. Core Concept: Investigative Power. \\n2. Logic: SC Commission kisi ko bhi summon bhej sakta hai aur shapath par gawahi le sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Yahi power National Commission for ST (338A) aur OBC (338B) ke paas bhi hai.

qe: Which Constitutional Body is known as the 'Watchdog of the Merit System' in India?
qh: भारत में 'मेरिट सिस्टम का प्रहरी' किस संवैधानिक निकाय को कहा जाता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Fair Recruitment. \\n2. Logic: UPSC ka mukhya kaam bina kisi bhedbhav ke sirf kabiliyat (merit) ke adhar par officers chun-na hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye 'Part XIV' ke tehat ek swatantra constitutional body hai.

qe: Article 165 provides for Advocate General. What is the minimum qualification for this post?
qh: अनुच्छेद 165 महाधिवक्ता का प्रावधान करता है। इस पद के लिए न्यूनतम योग्यता क्या है?
o: Qualified to be a High Court Judge (हाई कोर्ट जज बनने के योग्य)
e: 1. Core Concept: Legal Expertise. \\n2. Logic: Chunki wo State ka sabse bada law officer hai, isliye uska level HC judge ke barabar hona chahiye. \\n3. Extra Fact: Attorney General (Art 76) ke liye SC judge wali qualification honi chahiye.

qe: The 'Finance Commission' is constituted every 5 years. Does it have any 'Nominated' members?
qh: वित्त आयोग हर 5 साल में बनता है। क्या इसमें कोई 'मनोनीत' सदस्य होता है?
o: All are appointed by President (सभी राष्ट्रपति द्वारा नियुक्त होते हैं)
e: 1. Core Concept: Presidential Appointment. \\n2. Logic: Finance Commission (Art 280) ke Chairman aur baaki 4 sadasyo ko President hi appoint karte hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Inki eligibility Parliament kanoon dwara tay karti hai.

qe: Can the 'Comptroller and Auditor General' (CAG) be removed by the President at will?
qh: क्या राष्ट्रपति अपनी मर्जी से CAG को हटा सकते हैं?
o: No, only in like manner as SC Judge (नहीं, केवल SC जज की तरह)
e: 1. Core Concept: Independence of CAG. \\n2. Logic: CAG ko 'Pleasure of President' par nahi rakha gaya taaki wo bina dar ke audit kare. Ise hatane ke liye Parliament mein impeachment jaisa process chahiye. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye 'Security of Tenure' kehlata hai.

qe: Which Article forbids 'Discrimination' in the preparation of Electoral Rolls?
qh: मतदाता सूची तैयार करने में 'भेदभाव' पर कौन सा अनुच्छेद रोक लगाता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Secular Electoral Roll. \\n2. Logic: Dharam, jaati ya ling ke adhar par kisi ka naam voter list se nahi hataya ja sakta. \\n3. Extra Fact: Article 326 'Universal Adult Suffrage' (vote ka adhikar) deta hai.

qe: Who acts as the 'Advisory Body' to the President for disqualification of MPs?
qh: सांसदों की अयोग्यता के लिए राष्ट्रपति के लिए 'सलाहकार निकाय' के रूप में कौन कार्य करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 103. \\n2. Logic: 'Office of Profit' ya 'Insolvency' par President ko ECI ki rai leni padti hai aur wo rai 'Binding' (manne layak) hoti hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Dal-badal (Anti-defection) ke maamle mein ye power Speaker ke paas hoti hai.

qe: Article 151(2) says that CAG report of a State shall be submitted to:
qh: अनुच्छेद 151(2) कहता है कि राज्य की CAG रिपोर्ट किसे सौंपी जाएगी?
e: 1. Core Concept: Audit Reporting. \\n2. Logic: State audit report Governor ko di jati hai jo ise Vidhan Sabha ke samne rakhwata hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Union report President ko di jati hai.

qe: Which Amendment gave constitutional status to the 'National Commission for OBC' (NCBC)?
qh: किस संशोधन ने NCBC को संवैधानिक दर्जा दिया?
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 338B. \\n2. Logic: 2018 mein 102nd Amendment se NCBC ko constitutional body banaya gaya. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isne SC aur ST commission ki tarah hi powers payi hain.

qe: The 'Election Commission' has become a 'Multi-member body' permanently from which year?
qh: चुनाव आयोग किस वर्ष से स्थायी रूप से 'बहु-सदस्यीय निकाय' बन गया?
e: 1. Core Concept: Composition Change. \\n2. Logic: Pehle ye single-member tha. 1993 ke baad se 1 CEC aur 2 ECs ka system permanently lagu ho gaya. \\n3. Extra Fact: Teeno commissioners ki powers aur salary barabar (SC judge ke saman) hoti hai.

qe: The 'Union Public Service Commission' members submit their resignation to?
qh: UPSC के सदस्य अपना इस्तीफा किसे सौंपते हैं?
e: 1. Core Concept: Resignation. \\n2. Logic: Chunki unhe President appoint karta hai, isliye resignation bhi wahi jata hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: BPSC (Bihar) ke members apna resignation 'Governor' ko dete hain.

qe: Article 280(1) says the Finance Commission consists of a Chairman and how many other members?
qh: अनुच्छेद 280(1) के अनुसार वित्त आयोग में एक अध्यक्ष और कितने अन्य सदस्य होते हैं?
e: 1. Core Concept: Commission Size. \\n2. Logic: Total 5 log hote hain (1 Chairman + 4 Members). \\n3. Extra Fact: Chairman 'Public Affairs' ka expert hona chahiye aur members Accounts/Economy ke.

qe: Can the 'CAG' work in a private company after retirement from government service?
qh: क्या सरकारी सेवा से सेवानिवृत्ति के बाद CAG किसी निजी कंपनी में काम कर सकता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Post-retirement Ban. \\n2. Logic: Article 148(4) kehta hai ki CAG retire hone ke baad Central ya State Govt mein koi bhi office nahi le sakta. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye rule uski 'Impartiality' (nishpaksh-ta) bachane ke liye hai.

qe: Under Article 324, who appoints the 'Regional Election Commissioners'?
qh: अनुच्छेद 324 के तहत, 'क्षेत्रीय चुनाव आयुक्तों' की नियुक्ति कौन करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Appointment Authority. \\n2. Logic: President hi ECI se consult karke Regional Commissioners appoint karte hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Inka kaam elections ke waqt ECI ki madad karna hota hai.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Salary' of UPSC members?
qh: UPSC सदस्यों के 'वेतन' का प्रावधान कौन सा अनुच्छेद करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Financial Security. \\n2. Logic: Article 322 kehta hai ki UPSC ka kharch 'Consolidated Fund of India' par charged hoga. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ispar Parliament mein vote nahi hota taaki pressure na ban sake.

qe: The 'Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities' submits his report to:
qh: 'भाषाई अल्पसंख्यकों के लिए विशेष अधिकारी' अपनी रिपोर्ट किसे सौंपता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 350B. \\n2. Logic: Ye officer apni report President ko deta hai, jo ise Parliament mein rakhwate hain. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise 7th Amendment (1956) se add kiya gaya tha.

qe: Is the 'Solicitor General' of India a Constitutional post?
qh: क्या भारत का 'सॉलिसिटर जनरल' एक संवैधानिक पद है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Statutory vs Constitutional. \\n2. Logic: Samvidhan mein sirf Attorney General (Art 76) hai. Solicitor General kanoon dwara banaya gaya hai, isliye wo 'Statutory' hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Wo Attorney General ki madad karta hai.

qe: Which Article deals with the 'Protection of Civil Rights' regarding Untouchability and ECI role?
qh: अस्पृश्यता और ECI की भूमिका के संबंध में कौन सा अनुच्छेद है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Combined Logic. \\n2. Logic: 17 bhedbhav khatam karta hai aur 325 kehta hai ki bhedbhav ke adhar par voter list se naam nahi hateg. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye social aur political equality ka base hai.

qe: Who is the 'Custodian' of the purity of elections in India?
qh: भारत में चुनावों की शुद्धता का 'अभिरक्षक' कौन है?
e: 1. Core Concept: ECI Authority. \\n2. Logic: ECI hamesha 'Free and Fair' elections ensure karta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise Samvidhan ka 4th pillar bhi kaha jata hai (Democracy ke liye).

qe: The 'National Commission for STs' (NCST) became separate from NCSC by which amendment?
qh: NCST किस संशोधन द्वारा NCSC से अलग हुआ?
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 338A insertion. \\n2. Logic: 2003 mein 89th Amendment se dono commissions alag kar diye gaye. \\n3. Extra Fact: STs ki special jaruraton par focus karne ke liye ye kiya gaya.

qe: Who can remove 'Election Commissioners' (other than CEC)?
qh: चुनाव आयुक्तों (CEC के अलावा) को कौन हटा सकता है?
o: The President on recommendation of CEC (CEC की सिफारिश पर राष्ट्रपति)
e: 1. Core Concept: Constitutional Shield. \\n2. Logic: CEC ko SC judge ki tarah hatate hain, par ECs ko CEC ki sifaarish par President hata sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye CEC ko head banata hai.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Appointment of Members' of BPSC (State PSC)?
qh: BPSC (राज्य PSC) के सदस्यों की 'नियुक्ति' का प्रावधान कौन सा अनुच्छेद करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Recruitment of Members. \\n2. Logic: Article 316 appointment aur tenure ki baat karta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Member 6 saal ya 62 age tak pad par reh sakte hain.

qe: Can a member of 'National Commission for SC' be a member of Parliament?
qh: क्या SC आयोग का सदस्य सांसद हो सकता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Neutrality. \\n2. Logic: Ye bodies neutral honi chahiye, isliye political office avoid kiya jata hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Unka tenure 3 saal hota hai.

qe: Which Article deals with the 'Administrative Expenses' of CAG?
qh: CAG के 'प्रशासनिक व्यय' से कौन सा अनुच्छेद संबंधित है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Charged Expenditure. \\n2. Logic: CAG office ka sara kharch Consolidated Fund of India par charged hota hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Isme CAG aur unke staff ki salary shamil hai.

qe: Who is the 'Chief Executive Officer' of the GST Council?
qh: GST परिषद का 'मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी' कौन है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Council Structure. \\n2. Logic: Union Finance Minister hi Chairman hota hai aur saara control usi ka hota hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Is Council mein voting power 1/3 Centre ki hoti hai.

qe: Does the 'Advocate General' have the right to speak in the State Legislative Assembly?
qh: क्या महाधिवक्ता को राज्य विधानसभा में बोलने का अधिकार है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 177. \\n2. Logic: Wo sadasya nahi hai, par sarkar ka vakeel hone ke nate use bolne aur proceedings mein baithne ka haq hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Wo vote nahi de sakta.

qe: Which body is responsible for 'Audit of Local Bodies' in Bihar?
qh: बिहार में 'स्थानीय निकायों के ऑडिट' के लिए कौन जिम्मेदार है?
o: Both A and B (A और B दोनों)
e: 1. Core Concept: Overlap of Audit. \\n2. Logic: Normal audit State AG karta hai, par special guidelines CAG deta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye Article 243J aur 243Z se juda hai.

qe: The 'Election Commission' has its own staff. True or False?
qh: चुनाव आयोग का अपना स्टाफ होता है। सही या गलत?
o: False (गलत - यह दूसरे विभागों से लेता है)
e: 1. Core Concept: Resource efficiency. \\n2. Logic: ECI ke paas apna kafi kam staff hai. Elections ke waqt wo President/Governor se staff maangta hai (Article 324(6)). \\n3. Extra Fact: Isliye teachers aur police ki duty lagti hai.

qe: Under Article 338B, what is the tenure of 'National Commission for OBC' members?
qh: अनुच्छेद 338B के तहत, OBC आयोग के सदस्यों का कार्यकाल क्या है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Fixed Tenure. \\n2. Logic: SC, ST aur OBC teeno commissions ke sadasyo ka term 3 saal hota hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Inhe President appoint karta hai.

qe: Who decides the 'Jurisdiction' of State Public Service Commissions?
qh: राज्य लोक सेवा आयोगों का 'क्षेत्राधिकार' कौन तय करता है?
o: The Governor after State Law (राज्य कानून के बाद राज्यपाल)
e: 1. Core Concept: State Autonomy. \\n2. Logic: State Legislature kanoon banati hai aur Governor ise implement karta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Inki powers Article 320 mein hain.

qe: Which Article prohibits 'Double Membership' in Public Service Commissions?
qh: लोक सेवा आयोगों में 'दोहरी सदस्यता' पर कौन सा अनुच्छेद रोक लगाता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Independence. \\n2. Logic: Retire hone ke baad aap wahi pad dobara nahi le sakte ya kisi aur govt job mein nahi ja sakte. \\n3. Extra Fact: UPSC member UPSC ka chairman ban sakta hai.

qe: Who provides 'Staff' for conducting elections to Municipalities in Bihar?
qh: बिहार में नगरपालिकाओं के चुनाव कराने के लिए 'कर्मचारी' कौन प्रदान करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Local Election Support. \\n2. Logic: Article 243K(3) ke tehat Governor hi SEC ko staff provide karwata hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: SEC ka kaam sirf local elections dekhna hai.

qe: The 'Finance Commission' recommendations are 'Mandatory' for the Government.
qh: वित्त आयोग की सिफारिशें सरकार के लिए 'अनिवार्य' हैं।
e: 1. Core Concept: Advisory Nature. \\n2. Logic: Sarkar ise manne ke liye kanoonan majboor nahi hai, par morally ise mana jata hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise 'Fiscal Federalism' ka balancer kehte hain.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Removal of CEC'?
qh: CEC को हटाने का प्रावधान कौन सा अनुच्छेद करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Removal Ground. \\n2. Logic: 324(5) kehta hai ki CEC ko sirf SC judge ki tarah (Parliamentary removal) hi hataya ja sakta hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ise 'Independence' bachane ke liye kiya gaya hai.

qe: Which Body advises the Governor on 'Inter-state migration' of labor?
qh: कौन सा निकाय राज्यपाल को श्रम के 'अंतर-राज्यीय प्रवास' पर सलाह देता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Regional Coordination. \\n2. Logic: States ke beech mazdooron ke aane-jane par Council rai deti hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Iska Chairman PM hota hai.

qe: Who is the 'Highest Executive Officer' of the GST Council?
qh: GST परिषद का मुख्य अधिकारी कौन है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Political Head. \\n2. Logic: Ise Constitution ne hi Chairman banaya hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Har State ka Finance Minister iska member hota hai.

qe: Which Article provides for 'Special Officer for Scheduled Castes'?
qh: SCs के लिए 'विशेष अधिकारी' का प्रावधान कौन सा अनुच्छेद करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Institutional Evolution. \\n2. Logic: Pehle officer tha, ab 65th Amendment se 'Commission' ban gaya hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye National Commission for SC kehlata hai.

qe: The 'Election Commission' has Quasi-Legislative powers. What does it mean?
qh: चुनाव आयोग के पास 'अर्ध-विधायी' शक्तियां हैं। इसका क्या अर्थ है?
o: It can make rules like 'Model Code of Conduct' (आचार संहिता जैसे नियम बनाना)
It can make laws in Bihar
e: 1. Core Concept: Rule-making power. \\n2. Logic: Elections ko sahi tarike se karane ke liye ECI apne guidelines khud banata hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Iska best example 'Model Code of Conduct' (MCC) hai.

qe: The 'Consolidated Fund of India' is maintained by?
qh: भारत की 'संचित निधि' का रख-रखाव कौन करता है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Power of Purse. \\n2. Logic: Samvidhan ke tehat Sansad ki ijazat ke bina isse paisa nahi nikal sakta. \\n3. Extra Fact: Article 266 iska base hai.

qe: Who is the Chairman of the 'State Finance Commission' in Bihar?
qh: बिहार में 'राज्य वित्त आयोग' का अध्यक्ष कौन है?
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 243-I. \\n2. Logic: Governor hi har 5 saal mein ise banata hai. \\n3. Extra Fact: Ye Panchayato ke liye tax sharing tay karta hai.
